title: Escalate input
description: Move an Open or Escalated request to a person. A decider or a rule escalates when it will not decide under D→P, R, or R∧D→P, where an Escalate is also the decider's veto (docs/autonomy-levels.md:235-239, escalation.mode person :385). Under P and P+ an Escalate is a person passing the request on to someone else, also from Escalated. Escalate never opens a request: the escalation row of the class table (:257) is not a request class, it gives the holder of the request after Escalate (P at A2 to A4 in SDC's table).

sdc.decision.DecisionRequestId.title: DecisionRequestId
sdc.decision.DecisionRequestId.description: Id of a decision request, chosen by the driver: DR-<case>-<action or question id>-<n>.

sdc.decision.Principal.title: Principal
sdc.decision.Principal.description: Who decides: a person's name (operator), decider:<kind> (decider:model, decider:approve, decider:reject; decider:haiku in runs before D149), or silence for a default taken because nobody answered. Recorded as given, as Canon records a principal (canon-decisions/1).
